display_title: The Eldest Daughter and Her Path to Success
description:
To parents who had wanted a son, their eldest daughter was neither useful nor lovable. Born as the eldest daughter of the Tilord family, Ladis was always forced to make sacrifices. But after striving until her very body was broken, what she received in return was ultimately her family’s betrayal.

 *“It was all a futile dream. I shouldn’t have lived for my parents, for my siblings, for my family, or for the family name. I should have lived for myself!”*

In that final moment she thought was the end, Ladis was transported back to the age of sixteen.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
